source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of evaluating sources (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Information sources ko evaluate karna (parakhna, jaanchna) hamein yeh tay karne mein madad deta hai ke jo maloomat hum istemal kar rahe hain woh accurate (bilkul sahi) aur trustworthy (bharose ke qabil) hai ya nahi. Is process (kaam ke tareeqe) ke kai zaroori qadam (steps) hain, jo agle hisson (7.4.1.1 se 7.4.1.7) mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Information sources parakhne ke zaroori qadam (steps) kya hain? (Short question 5)
blocks.explanation: 1) Source evaluation: dekhein maloomat kahan se aayi (jaise sarkari website). 2) Credibility: kya likhne wala expert (mahir) ya us kaam ki authority (zimmedar aur ikhtiyar wala idara) hai (jaise chand ke liye Ruet-e-Hilal Committee). 3) Data provenance: data kahan se aaya aur kaise badla. 4) Primary sources: asal (original) cheez ko pehle rakhein. 5) Critical thinking: sawal karein aur alag alag viewpoints (soch ke zaviye) dekhein. 6) Red flags: author ka naam na hona, sensational (sansani phailane wali) headlines, references na hona. 7) Bias: dekhein ke source sirf ek taraf ki baat to nahi kar raha.

items: Sources parakhna = maloomat accurate aur trustworthy hai ya nahi; saat qadam agle hisson mein.
